rain.speaker: narrator
rain.hanzi: 下雨了！小兔子要打雨伞。
rain.pinyin: Xià yǔ le! Xiǎo tùzi yào dǎ yǔsǎn.
rain.english: It’s raining! The rabbit needs an umbrella.

sun.speaker: narrator
sun.hanzi: 太阳好大！小兔子要戴太阳镜。
sun.pinyin: Tàiyáng hǎo dà! Xiǎo tùzi yào dài tàiyángjìng.
sun.english: The sun is so bright! The rabbit needs sunglasses.

cold.speaker: narrator
cold.hanzi: 好冷啊！小兔子要戴围巾。
cold.pinyin: Hǎo lěng a! Xiǎo tùzi yào dài wéijīn.
cold.english: It’s so cold! The rabbit needs a scarf.

wear.speaker: narrator
wear.english: The rabbit wants to wear the {colour} {clothes}.
